import requests, re, time
API = "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php"
days = [f"August {i}" for i in range(1, 32)]
url_pat = re.compile(r"https?://(?:www\.)?(?:twitter\.com|x\.com)/[^\s<>]+/status/\d+")
counts = {}
for title in days:
    params = {
      "action": "query",
      "prop": "revisions",
      "titles": title,
      "rvstart": "2023-07-01T00:00:00Z",
      "rvdir": "older",
      "rvprop": "timestamp|content",
      "formatversion": "2",
      "format": "json"
    }
    resp = requests.get(API, params=params)
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        time.sleep(3)
        resp = requests.get(API, params=params)
    data = resp.json()
    page = data['query']['pages'][0]
    if 'revisions' not in page:
        counts[title] = 0
        continue
    content = page['revisions'][0]['content']
    refs = re.findall(r"<ref[\s\S]*?</ref>", content)
    urls = set()
    for ref in refs:
        for u in url_pat.findall(ref):
            urls.add(u)
    counts[title] = len(urls)
    time.sleep(0.3)
print(counts)
print("Total citations across August pages:", sum(counts.values()))
